locators.label: Corollary 1.8
locators.role: fixed distinct-shift terminal-log odd-total-power Mobius and Liouville cancellation
locators.statement: for fixed nonzero integer exponents c_0,...,c_k of odd sum, distinct integer shifts h_0,...,h_k, and arbitrary real sequences 1<=omega_m<=x_m with both tending to infinity, the normalized terminal logarithmic Mobius and Liouville correlations tend to zero

locators.label: Remark 1.5
locators.statement: Theorem 1.2 extends to fixed affine forms g_i(q_i*n+a*h_i), with the proof supplied in Appendix A

locators.label: Theorem A.1
locators.role: fixed affine-weight correlation structure and vanishing bridge
locators.statement: for fixed positive integer dilation parameters and arbitrary terminal windows, the correlation sequence on the fixed affine forms has the same periodic-structure and nonpretentious-product vanishing alternatives as Theorem 1.2
